thread.title: Apple schedules 'special event,' iPad and Mac updates expected

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple schedules 'special event,' iPad and Mac updates expected
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) will hold a special event on Oct. 30 in Brooklyn, New York, that is expected to focus on updates to the iPad and Apple's line of Mac computers. The company sent out invites and officially announced the event on its website (https://www.apple.com/apple-events/) Thursday, without any hints to what might be coming except for the fact that the image on each invitation appeared to be different (https://www.theverge.com/2018/10/18/17978622/apple-october-2018-event-ipad-pro-macbook-air-date-announcement). Apple just held an event in September to show off new iPhones and smartwatches (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-event-expected-to-show-off-new-iphones-apple-watch-live-blog-2018-09-12), but was curiously quiet about other product lines like iPad and Mac, leading many to believe the company would have a separate event for those products before the holiday shopping season. Apple shares gained slightly after the invites went out Thursday, but were still trading more than 1.5% lower on the day at 12:30 p.m. Eastern time, as tech stocks were taking another beating (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/dow-tumbles-350-points-as-technology-and-communication-services-stocks-tank-in-midday-trade-2018-10-18). Apple stock has gained 28.4% this year, as the S&P 500 index has increased 5.1%.
-Jeremy C. Owens; 1233ET
